char.name: Ribit
char.bio: The eldest of the three and the one who does the talking. Fast, never where the blow lands, and fond of letting you tire yourself out in the open before the dagger finds your throat.

char.name: Kharzuul the Ember-Old
char.bio: A red dragon older than the Mine, asleep on its clutch in the hot dark below the galleries. Its blood is the one the Snake Dragon carried, and the one the Blood Cult reads.
